name: Vella
source: "Vella" is a cosplayer who briefly visits VA-11 Hall-A along with Essentia on her way to the Athena Convention Center. She is cosplaying as Vella, a main character from the role-playing game [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YIIK:_A_Postmodern_RPG]YIIK: A Postmodern RPG[/url].
